CustomField.description: One-line title of the remote issue - Jira's issue.fields.summary, Asana's name. This is what a person calls the task; Name is the record's auto number and External_Key__c is the remote identifier, and neither reads as a title. Pushed to the source since build 08, so an edit here is no longer overwritten by the next inbound delivery.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Title of the work. Synced both ways: an edit here is pushed to the source system, and an edit there arrives here.
CustomField.label: Title
